description_en: Queries the automatic backup policy of a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查看PolarDB集群的自动备份策略
name: DescribeBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319131.html operation to query the details of all clusters in a region, including the cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319131.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

AdvancedDataPolicy.description_en:
The details of the advanced backup policy.

This parameter is not supported by PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL
AdvancedDataPolicy.description_zh:
高级备份策略详情。
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数

AutoCreated.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup policy is automatically generated by the system. The return value is:

true: The policy is generated by the system.

false: The policy is a custom policy
AutoCreated.description_zh:
是否为系统自动生成的备份策略，返回值如下：

true：系统生成策略
false：用户自定义策略

BakType.description_en:
The backup type. The return value is:

F: full backup
BakType.description_zh:
备份类型，返回值如下：
F：全量备份

DestRegion.description_en: The destination region of the backup policy

DestType.description_en:
The destination type of the backup policy. The return value is:

level1: level-1 backup

level2: level-2 backup

level2Cross: cross-region level-2 backup
DestType.description_zh:
备份策略目标类型，返回值如下：

level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份

DumpAction.description_en:
The method to convert a level-1 backup to a level-2 backup. The return value is:

copy: copy
DumpAction.description_zh:
一级备份转二级备份方式，返回值如下：

copy：复制

FilterKey.description_en:
The scheduling type. The return value is:

dayOfWeek: weekly schedule

dayOfMonth: monthly schedule

dayOfYear: yearly schedule

backupInterval: fixed-interval schedule

This parameter is returned only when FilterType is set to crontab
FilterKey.description_zh:
调度类型，返回值如下：

dayOfWeek：按周调度
dayOfMonth：按月调度
dayOfYear：按年调度
backupInterval：固定间隔调度

仅当FilterType为crontab时，返回该参数

FilterType.description_en:
The filter type for the advanced policy. The return value is:

crontab: recurring schedule

event: event-triggered schedule
FilterType.description_zh:
高级策略筛选类型，返回值如下：

crontab：周期调度
event：事件调度

OnlyPreserveOneEachDay.description_en:
The 24-hour backup retention policy.

true: Retain only the first backup set of the day if the backup set is created more than 24 hours ago.

false: Retain all backup sets
OnlyPreserveOneEachDay.description_zh:
24小时备份保留策略。
true：超过24小时仅保留当天第1个备份集
false：全保留

OnlyPreserveOneEachHour.description_en:
The hourly backup retention policy. Valid values:

true: Retain only the earliest backup set that is created within the hour.

false: Retain all backup sets
OnlyPreserveOneEachHour.description_zh:
每小时备份保留策略。取值如下：
true：超过1小时只保留每小时内最早的备份集。
false：保留全部备份集

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the backup policy

RetentionType.description_en:
The retention period type of the backup set. The return value is:

never: permanent retention

delay: retention for a specified number of days
RetentionType.description_zh:
备份集保留周期类型，返回值如下：

never：长期保留
delay：固定天数保留

RetentionValue.description_en: The number of days to retain the backup

SrcRegion.description_en: The source region of the backup policy

SrcType.description_en:
The source type of the backup policy. The return value is:

db: database cluster

level1: level-1 backup

level2: level-2 backup

level2Cross: cross-region level-2 backup
SrcType.description_zh:
备份策略源类型，返回值如下：

db：数据库集群
level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份

AdvancedPolicyOption.description_en:
The advanced backup policy option. Valid values:

enable: Advanced backup is enabled.

disable: Advanced backup is disabled. You can enable it.

notSupport: Advanced backup is not supported.

This parameter is not supported by PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL
AdvancedPolicyOption.description_zh:
高级备份策略选项。取值范围如下：
enable：已开启高级备份
disable：未开启高级备份，可选择开启
notSupport：不支持高级备份
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数

BackupFrequency.description_en:
The backup frequency. Valid values:

Normal (Default): Standard backup. A backup is performed once a day.

2/24H: Enhanced backup. A backup is performed every 2 hours.

3/24H: Enhanced backup. A backup is performed every 3 hours.

4/24H: Enhanced backup. A backup is performed every 4 hours.

If you enable enhanced backup, all backups that are completed within 24 hours are retained. For backups that are completed more than 24 hours ago, the system retains only the first backup that is completed after 00:00 every day. Other backups are deleted.

If you enable enhanced backup, the PreferredBackupPeriod parameter is automatically set to all days of the week (Monday to Sunday)
BackupFrequency.description_zh:
备份频率，取值如下：

Normal（默认）：常规备份，每天定时备份一次。
2/24H：增强备份，每2小时备份一次。
3/24H：增强备份，每3小时备份一次。
4/24H：增强备份，每4小时备份一次。

开启增强备份后，备份完成时间在24小时内的备份会全部保留。超过24小时的，系统将仅保留每日00:00点后完成的第一个备份，其他均被删除。
开启增强备份后，备份周期PreferredBackupPeriod参数会默认选择一周内的所有天数（即从周一至周日）

BackupPolicyLevel.description_en:
The level of the backup policy. Valid values:

Normal: standard backup

Advanced: advanced backup

This parameter is not supported by PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL
BackupPolicyLevel.description_zh:
当前备份策略等级。取值范围如下：
Normal：常规备份
Advanced：高级备份
PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数

BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion.description_en:
The policy to retain backups when you delete a cluster:

ALL: Retains all backups permanently.

LATEST: Retains the last backup permanently.

NONE (Default): Does not retain backup sets
BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion.description_zh:
删除集群时是否保留备份：

ALL：长期保留全部备份。
LATEST：长期保留最后一个备份。
NONE（默认）：不保留备份集

DataLevel1BackupFrequency.description_en:
The backup frequency. Valid values:

Normal (Default): Standard backup. A backup is performed once a day.

2/24H: High-frequency backup. A backup is performed every 2 hours.

3/24H: High-frequency backup. A backup is performed every 3 hours.

4/24H: High-frequency backup. A backup is performed every 4 hours.

* This parameter is not supported by PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL.

- This parameter is not supported if the cross-region backup feature is unavailable in the region where your PolarDB for MySQL cluster resides. For more information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）.

- This parameter is not recommended if the advanced backup feature is enabled. Use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead
DataLevel1BackupFrequency.description_zh:
备份频率，取值如下：

Normal（默认）：常规备份，每天定时备份一次。
2/24H：高频备份，每2小时备份一次。
3/24H：高频备份，每3小时备份一次。
4/24H：高频备份，每4小时备份一次。

* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域不支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel1BackupPeriod.description_en:
The cycle of a level-1 backup. Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday

* Select at least two days. Separate multiple values with commas (,).

- This parameter is not supported by PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL.

- This parameter is not supported if the cross-region backup feature is unavailable in the region where your PolarDB for MySQL cluster resides. For more information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）.

- This parameter is not recommended if the advanced backup feature is enabled. Use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead
DataLevel1BackupPeriod.description_zh:
一级备份周期，取值范围如下： 
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

* 至少需要选择2天，多个值之间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域不支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel1BackupRetentionPeriod.description_en:
The retention period of level-1 backups. Valid values: 3 to 14. Unit: days.

This parameter is not recommended if the advanced backup feature is enabled. Use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead
DataLevel1BackupRetentionPeriod.description_zh:
一级备份保留周期，取值范围为3~14，单位为天。
开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel1BackupTime.description_en:
The time range when an automatic backup is performed. The time is in the `hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ` format and is displayed in UTC. The specified time range must be a 1-hour interval on the hour, such as `14:00Z-15:00Z`.

This parameter is not supported by PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle) and PolarDB for PostgreSQL.

This parameter is not supported if the cross-region backup feature is unavailable in the region where your PolarDB for MySQL cluster resides. For more information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）
DataLevel1BackupTime.description_zh:
执行自动备份的时间段，格式为`hh:mmZ-hh:mmZ`（UTC时间），且输入的数值必须为间隔1个小时的整点，如`14:00Z-15:00Z`。

PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
如果您的PolarDB MySQL版所在的地域不支持跨地域备份功能，将不支持该参数。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）

DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRegion.description_en:
The destination region of the cross-region level-2 backup. For more information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）.

This parameter is not recommended if the advanced backup feature is enabled. Use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead
DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRegion.description_zh:
二级备份跨地域备份区域。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见[概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html）。

开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies

DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRetentionPe.description_en:
The retention period of cross-region level-2 backups. Valid values:

0: The level-2 backup feature is disabled.

30 to 7300: The retention period of level-2 backups in days.

-1: The level-2 backups are permanently retained.

* When you create a cluster, the default value is 0. This means the cross-region backup feature for level-2 backups is disabled.

- This parameter is not recommended if the advanced backup feature is enabled. Use the AdvancedDataPolicies parameter instead
DataLevel2BackupAnotherRegionRetentionPe.description_zh:
二级备份跨地域备份保留周期。取值范围如下：

0：关闭二级备份功能。

30～7300：二级备份保留周期，单位为天。

-1：二级备份长期保留。


- 创建集群时，默认取值为0，即关闭二级备份跨地域备份功能。
- 开启高级备份后，该参数不建议使用，请使用参数 AdvancedDataPolicies
